title: Hinomori Shizuku — Graduating To Independence〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us for another MORE MORE JUMP! livestream!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finally! Hi, Shizuku!>
<Hello!>
<Congrats on your TV appearance!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it sounds like some of your fans want to jump right in with our TV appearance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Who here saw us on idol Hazard?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I did! It was so awesome!>
<I was cracking up because you were such a nervous wreck, Minori.>
<I learned about your streams on iHaz!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! So many comments!
They really saw us on TV!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And some seem to be watching for the first time after seeing us on iHaz. Thank you all for joining us. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, there's way more people here than usual today.>
<Welcome newbies!>
<MMJ's the best...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, we'd like to thank everyone who sent us messages and such after it aired.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, for today's stream, we'll be discussing what happened on iHaz.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's right!
We're calling this the “Top Secret iHaz Talk Show☆”!!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, does that mean we get to hear what happened behind the scenes?>
<Cool! Tell us more!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we start by asking Minori how things went after stuffing her face with snacks in the green room and tensing up way too much during the shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Airi...!
They don't need to know about what I ate!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She stuffed her face lol.>
<That's Minori for you! What did they serve?>
<Yeah, tell us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys wanna know?
Then, I'll describe the green room while talking more about how the shoot went!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As a result, I froze up a few times... But I talked it over with Haruka afterwards, so I promise to do better next time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori...
Next...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your turn, Shizuku!>
<How'd it go for you, Shizuku?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, they want to hear from you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did receive a huge wave of support after it aired, so it makes sense that they want to hear what you have to say about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, mind going next for us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How did it go...? To summarize briefly, I was very nervous the entire time...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, you were too?>
<Yeah. After all, Cheerful * Days was there.>
<Totally understandable. I was really afraid of what Arisa was gonna say.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As I mentioned during our shoot, I was given a script each time I made an appearance when I was still in Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the others would dive in to rescue me whenever I had to go off-script...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Again, I ended up being a terrible lead.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, that's why I felt motivated to do my best for this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't want to depend on a script or use my friends as a crutch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wanted to show Arisa, the others and everybody watching that I've grown as an idol and can stand on my own now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And to say, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<We heard you loud and clear, Shizuku!>
<Seeing you on TV made me so happy to be your fan!>
<I promise to follow you forever!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our stream went really well today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was our first one after appearing on TV. Still, it was nice to see so many new people joining us for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we got a ton of new subscribers. That means our archived streams should get even more views...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi...?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This comment... I think it's a message for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Dear Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I was a huge admirer of the mysterious and perfect version of you from when you were still with Cheerful * Days.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Which is why I had trouble accepting the MORE MORE JUMP! version of you... I actually stopped being your fan for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <But what you said on iHaz made me realize that you're still that person I admired so much.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for losing faith in you and even hating you for a bit. But, I hope you'll welcome me back as your fan.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This comment... I'm starting to tear up...! I'm so happy for you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(What I said... How I really feel...
They really heard me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (There may be others who felt the same thing as this person...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if I can keep reaching out to them one by one, I may be able to help them heal.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I need to make each word I say count moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the sake of my old fans, as well as those who've accepted me as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!)
